Encryption fixture created with mutool clean AES-256. Resource fixtures are actual PDF page/image dictionaries.

native_anchor_observation: Observed with real pdfinfo/pdftotext -layout during TestPDFNativeExecutableExtraction; Unicode codepoint half-open spans, no bounding boxes. Live OCR offsets are recomputed from each actual transcript and are not fixed to the deterministic callback output.
